title: next() Function
definition: The `next()` function is the mechanism that passes control from one middleware function to the next in the stack. If a middleware function does not end the request-response cycle (by calling `res.send`, `res.json`, etc.), it **must** call `next()`. If it doesn't, the request will hang indefinitely and the client will eventually time out.
